name: Asahi Intecc Co., Ltd.
summary: Asahi Intecc Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of medical devices in Japan, the United States, Europe, China, and internationally. The company operates through the Medical and Device segments. It provides guide wires, guiding catheters, balloon catheters, penetration catheters, microcatheter for endovascular treatment; gastrointestinal endoscopy device such as guidewire and dilator; and robotic system and software.
